tmp:1596: kavod di-kedushah — holy honor/glory, the sanctified honor attained only through humility, elevated via converts and penitents (as opposed to profane honor)
tmp:1597: malakh — 'angel' in the verse, read as symbol of the lamdan (Torah scholar) and the angel Metatron (Mem-Tet), guardian of the lower covenant of Oral Torah study
tmp:1599: the heart's yearning to learn Torah — the burning desire itself, which counts as actual study for one unable to learn (an am ha'aretz, bookless, or in the wilderness)
tmp:1600: limmud mitokh ha-sefer — study from within a physical book, the aspect virtually fulfilled by the heart's longing when actual study is impossible
tmp:1601: limmudei Hashem — 'those taught of God' (Isaiah 54:13), epithet for children/sons whose souls are saved when justice rescues the oppressed
tmp:1605: above human intellect — the supra-rational realm beyond sekhel enoshi, like a segulah-remedy; identified with the makkifin (transcendent encompassing lights)
tmp:1606: the sayings and speech of the Jewish person — Israelite utterance that illuminates the places ('vegetable town') where one must do teshuvah (from the amrei inshei saying)
tmp:1608: shalosh kavin — the three kabbalistic lines/pillars (right-left-center), mapped onto the Talmudic rule to divide one's money in thirds: merchandise, land, and cash in hand (Bava Metzia 42)
tmp:1609: simchah ve-chedvah — joy and gladness as the source through which one attains holy boldness (azut di-kedushah), per 'the joy of the Lord is your strength'
tmp:1611: machar — 'tomorrow' in Pharaoh's locust warning, symbol of the World to Come, the future day of receiving reward (Eruvin 22a)
tmp:1612: le-atid lavo — the eschatological Future to Come, era of receiving reward when the paradox of the Vacated Space (challal ha-panui) will be understood
tmp:1613: drawing Shabbat's sanctity into the six weekdays — sanctifying the profane days to repair the serpent's 39 curses/labors ('doing your affairs on My holy day')
tmp:1614: tempering excessive spiritual ardor — the act of contracting (tzimtzum) the heart's burning for God so it not consume the body, via Torah as the lungs' wings fanning the heart
tmp:1615: 'kol basar yachdav' — the phrase 'all flesh together' (Isaiah 40:5), read as the ingathering of all souls by the wise soul-taker (tzaddik)
tmp:1616: gathering of all the souls — the tzaddik's collecting of nefashot, per 'he who takes souls is wise' (Proverbs 11:30), signified by 'all flesh together'
tmp:1617: drawing converts and ba'alei teshuvah near — the act of bringing gerim and penitents close, possible only through Torah ('let your springs spread outward')
tmp:1618: beholding the light of the tzaddik — the perception attained when the intellect is perfected via charity, blocked by murky deeds that cloud the mind
tmp:1619: witnessing the downfall of the wicked — seeing mappalat resha'im, possible only through the aspect of the Land of Israel/the Right ('sit at My right hand')
tmp:1620: toiling in Torah until one knows and understands it — the laborious study that heals and elevates the soul to its root
tmp:1621: healing one's soul by raising it to its root-place — the soul-cure achieved through exertion in Torah study
tmp:1622: ishah chakhamah — 'wise woman' (chokhmot nashim, Proverbs 14:1) as figure for the Holy Spirit/Holy Tongue that the serpent seeks to seduce
tmp:1623: shnayim mikra — 'twice Scripture' (the weekly reading practice), midrashically read from 'bekerev shanim' as the Holy Tongue that arouses the power of Creation
tmp:1624: lashon shel zehorit — the crimson thread of Yom Kippur (which whitened when sins were forgiven), linked by wordplay to 'zohar ha-rakia' (radiance of the firmament)
tmp:1626: leshon Targum — the Aramaic translation-language, aspect of tardemah (deep sleep) whose good is elevated to build the Holy Tongue and fell the seventy nations' tongues
tmp:1628: guarding memory (zikaron) — protecting remembrance, seated between the eyes, from falling into the evil eye and death-of-the-heart which breed forgetfulness
tmp:1629: empowering the three 'legs' to walk properly — giving strength via threefold blessing to the legs/supports (faith-truth-Shabbat) so they can stride correctly
tmp:1630: hesped — funeral eulogy, which rectifies the departure of glory caused by a tzaddik's passing; forbidden on Chanukah (Shabbat 21b)
tmp:1631: great zeal (zerizut) in divine service — running exceedingly swiftly on the path, requiring mighty exertion ('rejoices like a strong man to run a course')
tmp:1632: the forty (Mem) days of the embryo's formation (Niddah 30) — gestation period symbolized by the closed final-mem formed from the womb's two dalet-doors
tmp:1633: people of great spiritual stature — the 'great ones' (gedolim) as a rank of persons, contrasted with the small, in bringing all to judgment/prayer
tmp:1635: yanuka — the child/infant (of Rav's dictum 'smite the child only with a shoe-strap'), symbol of the lesser luminary (moon) and the state of sleep
tmp:1636: people of small spiritual stature — the 'small ones' (ketanim) as a rank of persons, contrasted with the great, in the scheme of judgment/prayer
tmp:1637: 'me-achar alot' behind holiness — unholy melody drawn from 'behind the nursing ewes' (Psalm 78:70), i.e., neginah originating outside/behind kedushah, unlike prophetic holy song
tmp:1639: illuminating the sparkling of the letters in everything — making the otiyot embedded in all things (esp. foods) shine via perfected Holy Tongue, enabling dream interpretation
tmp:1640: souls bearing fruit by doing God's will — the state in which the neshamot 'make fruits,' illuminating the eyes of the Master of the Field (sedeh tzofim vs. sedeh bokhim)
tmp:1643: ma'arikh rucheih — 'lengthening one's spirit' (Aramaic for erekh apayim), patience/long-breath of the ruach-chayim drawn from Torah, absent in Egypt's kotzer ruach
tmp:1644: nullifying strife (machaloket) — the abolition of dispute via hand-clapping, uniting left (Korach) with right (Aharon) into oneness
tmp:1646: handing the war over to God — the act of entrusting the battle to Hashem to fight, the tikkun for heretical thoughts falling on the upright amid strife
tmp:1647: nullifying the wicked's thoughts — the cancellation of heretical thoughts (machshavot resha'im) that befall upright people, achieved by giving the battle to God
tmp:1648: tefiloteinu — 'our prayers,' the eighteen Amidah blessings (chai birkhaan) through which Israel overrides nature ('mother of all life') and subdues heretics
